-- The profile, its published versions (newest first) and the active one.
SELECT json_build_object(
  'profile', json_build_object('slug', p.slug, 'name', p.name, 'active_version_id', p.active_version_id),
  'versions', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', v.id, 'version', v.version, 'label', v.label, 'config', v.config, 'note', v.note,
      'change_summary', v.change_summary, 'published_by', v.published_by, 'published_at', v.published_at,
      'archived_at', (SELECT a.archived_at FROM icp_version_archive a WHERE a.version_id = v.id)
    ) ORDER BY v.version DESC)
    FROM icp_config_versions v WHERE v.profile_id = p.id
  ), '[]'::json)
) AS body
FROM icp_profiles p
WHERE p.slug = 'psycray-default';

-- The profile's active version, to validate against and diff from.
SELECT p.id AS profile_id, p.slug, p.active_version_id, v.config AS active_config,
       (SELECT max(version) FROM icp_config_versions WHERE profile_id = p.id) AS max_version
FROM icp_profiles p
JOIN icp_config_versions v ON v.id = p.active_version_id
WHERE p.slug = 'psycray-default';

-- Publish: insert the new immutable version and make it active, atomically.
-- The WHERE on active_version_id guards against a concurrent publish.
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO icp_config_versions (profile_id, version, label, config, note, change_summary, published_by)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, NULLIF($5, ''), $6::jsonb, $7)
  RETURNING *
), activated AS (
  UPDATE icp_profiles p
  SET active_version_id = (SELECT id FROM inserted)
  WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.active_version_id = $8
  RETURNING p.id
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'id', i.id, 'version', i.version, 'label', i.label, 'config', i.config, 'note', i.note,
  'change_summary', i.change_summary, 'published_by', i.published_by, 'published_at', i.published_at
) AS version
FROM inserted i;

-- Every validated company with what rescoring needs, plus the active config.
SELECT iv.id AS active_config_id, iv.config AS active_config,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'domain', cr.domain, 'icp_score', cr.icp_score, 'icp_tier', cr.icp_tier, 'icp_breakdown', cr.icp_breakdown,
      'synthesized_research', cr.synthesized_research, 'company_facts', cr.company_facts
    ))
    FROM company_research cr WHERE cr.status = 'validated'
  ), '[]'::json) AS rows
FROM icp_profiles ip
JOIN icp_config_versions iv ON iv.id = ip.active_version_id
WHERE ip.slug = 'psycray-default';

-- Bulk save: new scores on company_research (research date unchanged) and
-- one history row per rescored company.
WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM json_to_recordset($1::json)
    AS t(domain text, score int, tier text, result jsonb, evidence jsonb)
), updated AS (
  UPDATE company_research cr
  SET icp_score = i.score, icp_tier = i.tier, icp_breakdown = i.result
  FROM input i
  WHERE cr.domain = i.domain AND cr.status = 'validated'
  RETURNING cr.domain
), history AS (
  INSERT INTO icp_score_history
    (domain, trigger, score, tier, algorithm_version, config_version, config_version_id,
     snapshot_id, evidence_fingerprint, result, evidence, calculated_at)
  SELECT i.domain, 'recalculate', i.score, i.tier, i.result->>'algorithm_version', i.result->>'config_version',
         $2::int, i.result->>'snapshot_id', i.result->>'evidence_fingerprint', i.result, i.evidence,
         (i.result->>'calculated_at')::timestamptz
  FROM input i JOIN updated u ON u.domain = i.domain
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT count(*)::int AS saved FROM history;

-- A company's score history, newest first (the result's large fields are left out).
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(h ORDER BY h.calculated_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS entries
FROM (
  SELECT id, trigger, score, tier, algorithm_version, config_version, config_version_id, snapshot_id,
         evidence_fingerprint, calculated_at, result->'change' AS change, result->>'qualification' AS qualification
  FROM icp_score_history
  WHERE domain = $1
  ORDER BY calculated_at DESC
  LIMIT 25
) h;

-- Rate limit (whole app): counts recent requests and records this one only if under the limits.
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 minute')::int AS last_minute,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 day')::int AS last_day
  FROM icp_assistant_log
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO icp_assistant_log (instruction_chars)
  SELECT $1 FROM counts WHERE last_minute < $2 AND last_day < $3
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT c.last_minute, c.last_day, (SELECT id FROM logged) AS log_id FROM counts c;

-- Archive or restore one version. Never deletes a version. Version 1 and the
-- active version are never archived; the response says why.
WITH v AS (
  SELECT v.id, v.version, (p.active_version_id = v.id) AS is_active
  FROM icp_config_versions v JOIN icp_profiles p ON p.id = v.profile_id
  WHERE v.id = $1
), archived AS (
  INSERT INTO icp_version_archive (version_id)
  SELECT id FROM v WHERE $2::boolean AND version > 1 AND NOT is_active
  ON CONFLICT (version_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING version_id
), restored AS (
  DELETE FROM icp_version_archive
  WHERE version_id = $1 AND NOT $2::boolean AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v)
  RETURNING version_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM v)::int AS found,
       (SELECT version FROM v) AS version,
       COALESCE((SELECT is_active FROM v), false) AS is_active,
       $2::boolean AS archive;
